articles.title: Mumbai: BMC Scraps ₹1-Crore Blood Bank Analyser Amid Fears Of Costlier Blood Tests
articles.description: BMC has cancelled the procurement of a Rs 1-crore immunohematology analyser after concerns that its proprietary reagents would increase blood testing costs and create dependence on a single vendor. Critics also questioned the machine's cost-effectiveness and its suitability for civic hospitals serving economically weaker patients.

articles.title: CM Mohan Yadav Announces Police Battalion For Khandwa, Transfers ₹3,300 Crore To 82 Lakh Farmers
articles.description: Chief Minister Mohan Yadav announced a police battalion for Khandwa and said the Khandwa-Mundi road tender would be issued before August 15. He also transferred over ₹3,300 crore to 82 lakh farmers under the Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana and highlighted irrigation, rural infrastructure and farmer welfare initiatives across Madhya Pradesh.

articles.title: Telangana approves 30-year lease of Urdu Academy land to private company
articles.description: The Minorities Welfare Department's approval to lease over one acre of Urdu Academy land in Serilingampally to a private company for 30 years has sparked concerns. Community members have questioned the absence of a tender process and sought cancellation of the government order
